coldStartNote: 2026-09-10: journal file did not exist at session start (git show origin/main:... returned 'path does not exist'). This is the first entry — no prior-cycle continuity to compare against.

Fixed same cycle, see docs/audit/findings-staging/2026-09-10-nighthawk-session-midnight-hour24-carry-until-close.md and PR (fix/nighthawk-session-midnight-hour24).
